Workflow: find_object
When to use: when the object needed for the task is not immediately visible and must be located in the environment
Steps:
1. go to {location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)

Workflow: pick_up_and_place
When to use: when an object is found and needs to be moved to a specific destination
Steps:
1. take {object} from {location} (picking up the object)
2. go to {destination} (moving to the target location)
3. move {object} to {destination} (placing the object in the correct location)

Workflow: search_multiple_locations
When to use: when the object is not found in the first location and must be systematically searched across multiple locations
Steps:
1. go to {location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. go to {next_location} (searching another location for {object})
4. examine {next_location} (checking if {object} is present)

Workflow: search_all_locations
When to use: when the object is not found in the initial locations and must be searched across all possible locations in the environment
Steps:
1. go to {location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. go to {next_location} (searching another location for {object})
4. examine {next_location} (checking if {object} is present)
5. repeat steps 3 and 4 for all remaining locations until {object} is found

Workflow: locate_and_move_object
When to use: when an object must be located in the environment and then moved to a specific destination
Steps:

2. examine {location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. take {object} from {location} (picking up the object)
4. go to {destination} (moving to the target location)
5. move {object} to {destination} (placing the object in the correct location)

Workflow: search_and_move_to_receptacle
When to use: when an object is found in one location and needs to be moved to a specific receptacle in another location
Steps:
1. go to {object_location} (searching for {object})
2. examine {object_location} (checking if {object} is present)
3. take {object} from {object_location} (picking up the object)
4. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the target receptacle location)
5. move {object} to {receptacle} (placing the object in the correct receptacle)

Workflow: move_object_to_receptacle
When to use: when an object is already in hand and needs to be placed into a specific receptacle
Steps:
1. go to {receptacle_location} (moving to the target receptacle location)
2. move {object} to {receptacle} (placing the object in the correct receptacle)

<<<WORKFLOWS_END>>>
